assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.
assumptions.basis: brief/site-package/ranges/planning_limits.json lists five official_planning_controls (floor_area_ratio, building_height_m, building_density, green_ratio, setback_m) as status=missing with required_for_final_submission=true.
assumptions.resolution: Replace with the approved control figures once the prequalification pack is issued; every intensity metric in this package is then recomputed against them.

assumptions.statement: All areas derive from the repository PROVISIONAL site polygon; no official redline is published in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Every absolute area and every ratio in metrics.json inherits this boundary. Recomputed site area is 0.11% from the published 11.4 km2 figure, but the polygon is not a redline and must not be used as one.
assumptions.basis: brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson (official_boundary=false); the eligibility text states the organiser's missing boundary data must not block scoring.
assumptions.resolution: Re-run the geometry generators against the official redline; the land-use partition is built by intersecting a plane tiling with the boundary, so it re-derives without redesign.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are the organiser's provisional extents, not surveyed boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Per-area figures are indicative. The aggregate is within 0.43% of the published 368.4 ha, which is a consistency check, not a confirmation.
assumptions.basis: provisional_boundaries.geojson features PROV-KEY-001/002/003 carry official_boundary=false; ranges/planning_limits.json publishes the three areas.
assumptions.resolution: Substitute the official key-area polygons from the prequalification pack.

assumptions.statement: Land-use codes are validated against the project code subset; their SEMANTICS follow the published national standard, whose full annex is not in the repository snapshot.
assumptions.impact: Code assignment is defensible at the level used. Parcels held at category level carry code_granularity=category with a stated reason rather than a guessed leaf code.
assumptions.basis: brief/site-package/enums/land_use_codes.json ships 16 codes with source_id SRC-2023-MNR-LAND-USE-CLASSIFICATION and the caveat 'Import the full official code table before final statutory planning use'; the cited gov.cn page is the issuing notice only.
assumptions.resolution: Import the official annex and promote category-level parcels to leaf codes.

assumptions.statement: The land-use layer is an authored exact partition of the design boundary, not a survey of existing use.
assumptions.impact: Coverage is exact by construction (gap 0.000 m2, pairwise overlap 0.000 m2) because the plane is tiled and intersected with the boundary. It states proposed structure, and must not be read as a record of current land use.
assumptions.basis: Generated by build_land_use.py; every feature carries geometry_role=design_proposal and source_type=agent_generated_design.
assumptions.resolution: Overlay the official current-use survey; the partition then becomes the proposal layer against a measured base.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are 20 indicative massing envelopes covering roughly 3% of the boundary, not surveyed or proposed buildings.
assumptions.impact: Any belt-wide figure derived from them (density, floor area, FAR) describes the illustrative massing only and is not comparable to a plot-level or district figure.
assumptions.basis: geometry/buildings.geojson, geometry_role=design_proposal, typed against enums/building_types.json; no heights or plot ratios are asserted as controls.
assumptions.resolution: Replace with surveyed footprints plus an approved massing scheme.

assumptions.statement: Storey counts per building type are proposed by this submission, not approved controls: ai_r_and_d=8, community_service=3, cultural=4, existing_retained=6, incubator=6, lab=5, mixed_use=8, mobility_hub=3, office=12, talent_apartment=18.
assumptions.impact: total_floor_area_sqm and floor_area_ratio are functions of these authored numbers; changing them changes both.
assumptions.basis: Authored in gen_metrics.py and declared inline on the affected metrics; agent.1 forbids stating building height as a settled judgement, so these are inputs to a sample calculation, never a height control.
assumptions.resolution: Replace with the approved height and intensity conditions, then recompute both dependent metrics.

assumptions.statement: The reported floor area ratio is a SAMPLE ratio over this submission's own massing, not a district FAR and not a design intent.
assumptions.impact: It reads far below any real district figure because the massing covers ~3% of the belt. Reported as sample FAR with the caveat attached; without that wording it would be a forbidden claim under agent.1.
assumptions.basis: agent.1 forbidden_claims_zh forbids 给出容积率...结论; planning_limits.json lists statutory FAR as missing.
assumptions.resolution: Superseded outright by the approved FAR control; this metric is then deleted rather than corrected.

assumptions.statement: Every ratio metric divides by the provisional site area, so all ratios inherit the boundary assumption even where the numerator is exact.
assumptions.impact: green_ratio, public_space_ratio, road_ratio and building_density are no more certain than A-BOUNDARY-001, regardless of how precisely their numerators are measured.
assumptions.basis: gen_metrics.py computes each ratio against site_area_sqm; only site_area_sqm previously declared the provisional boundary, which understated the reach of that gap.
assumptions.resolution: Recompute against the official redline area; numerators are unaffected.

assumptions.statement: Road area is the UNION of carriageway polygons, not the sum, because carriageways intersect at junctions.
assumptions.impact: road_area_sqm is 6,339.8 m2 lower than the naive sum. The layer-level sum-equals-union assertion is explicitly exempted for roads, with the reason recorded, rather than silenced globally.
assumptions.basis: check_geometry_integrity.py; the exemption is scoped to roads only, every other layer stays asserted.
assumptions.resolution: None needed; this is a stated method, not a gap.

assumptions.statement: Phase extents are proposed sequencing envelopes, not committed programmes, funding or approved delivery boundaries.
assumptions.impact: phasing_area_sqm describes proposed staging only; no schedule, budget or commitment is claimed.
assumptions.basis: geometry/phasing.geojson, geometry_role=design_proposal; stating a phase as decided would breach the rule against presenting concepts as settled government decisions.
assumptions.resolution: Align with the official implementation programme when published.

assumptions.statement: Two key-area shares are reported and they are NOT interchangeable: 32.4% is the key-area POLYGON share of the design area; 37.9% is the full-width CROSS-SECTION share at the same latitudes.
assumptions.impact: Any sentence using one number must name which. The headline argument uses the 32.4% polygon share.
assumptions.basis: Both are recomputed in EPSG:4548; FIG 02 carries both with a note that they measure different things.
assumptions.resolution: None needed; this is a disambiguation, not a gap.

assumptions.statement: The heritage park's slow-mobility breakpoints are stated by the official announcement to exist, but their locations are not published anywhere in the site package.
assumptions.impact: The survey layer covers the whole corridor rather than named points. Hatching only selected segments would imply located knowledge this package does not have.
assumptions.basis: The announcement requests that breakpoints be resolved but publishes no inventory; the figure legend distinguishes whole-line survey from the separate fact of no key-area support.
assumptions.resolution: Replace the whole-line survey with a measured breakpoint inventory once surveyed on site.

assumptions.statement: Staffed review windows operate 08:00-20:00; outside those hours the network falls from 13 points to the 3 tier-1 points.
assumptions.impact: The reachability guarantee is time-banded. The daytime worst walk is 417 m; after 20:00 the worst walk is 2,238 m / 46.6 min, which is published rather than averaged away. A claim about a ROOM is not a claim about a PERSON.
assumptions.basis: The staffing hours are stated in the signal-box design; the night figure is recomputed over the tier-1 subset.
assumptions.resolution: Named as 待深化 in the proposal; a night staffing model would retire it.

assumptions.statement: International reference cases are cited for MECHANISM only. They are excluded from sources.json, carry no figures, and are never used to argue a local metric.
assumptions.impact: The case material supports how an arrangement works, never what it would measure here. This scope declaration is what keeps the cases inside the evidence rules.
assumptions.basis: The 取用边界声明 in the proposal fences all six cases; sources.json holds only the five formally usable registry entries.
assumptions.resolution: None needed; the boundary is the safeguard.

assumptions.statement: The review-line funding model is described as a mechanism drawn from public regulatory precedent, with no rates, budgets or caseload figures.
assumptions.impact: The proposal states who pays, on what basis and through what account, but asserts no number. A figure here would be an unverifiable claim about a body that does not yet exist.
assumptions.basis: Mechanism read from published ombudsman and universal-service funding documents; deliberately excluded from sources.json because it argues design logic, not local fact.
assumptions.resolution: A funded pilot would replace the mechanism description with measured cost.

assumptions.statement: Constraint features deliberately NEST, so the constraints layer overlaps itself by design; the zero-overlap assertion applies to the other seven layers.
assumptions.impact: A pairwise-overlap check run blindly across all nine layers reports a false defect of about 1,098 ha. The exemption is named per layer with its reason, never applied globally.
assumptions.basis: geometry/constraints.geojson carries five layer codes and mixes LineString with Polygon; graded protection ranges are concentric by nature.
assumptions.resolution: None needed; this is a stated property of the layer.

assumptions.statement: Cross-corridor connectivity is specified as a topology and a service guarantee, not as a bridge, tunnel or any engineering solution.
assumptions.impact: The four-quadrant crossing is drawn as a connectivity graph in three states with a guarantee matrix. Naming a structure would be an engineering implementation conclusion, which agent.1 forbids.
assumptions.basis: agent.1 forbidden_claims_zh forbids 道路红线或工程实施结论; four links rather than three so the cycle survives any single edge failing.
assumptions.resolution: A transport engineering study selects the structure; the guarantee matrix becomes its brief.

assumptions.statement: This package does not use the Jing-Zhang line's zigzag switchback as a design motif, and makes no claim about its location, mileage, or distance from this corridor. The cleared fact pack contains no railway history, so no historical siting claim is available to this package.
assumptions.impact: No spatial move in this package derives from the switchback. On-site cultural anchors are limited to the ones the official announcement itself names.
assumptions.basis: Rule, not evidence: where no cleared historical source exists, a motif that would need one is not used. This assumption asserts no historical fact and cites none.
assumptions.resolution: None needed; this is a boundary on what may be claimed. Any historical siting must be supplied and cleared by the heritage/archival authorities in a later stage.
